pages.title: Nutrient Decay
pages.text: Your nutrient bars do not stay full forever.$(br2)Every $(bold)60 seconds$(), all six bars lose a small amount — regardless of what you eat. Stop eating entirely and your nutrition will gradually fall back toward zero.$(br2)This is $(thing)nutrient decay$(). It is always running.

pages.title: What This Means
pages.text: You cannot front-load your nutrition at the start of a session and forget about it.$(br2)Nourished expects you to eat $(bold)consistently$() — not just once.$(br2)$(italic)The decay rate is gentle by design. A well-fed player going mining for 10 minutes will not come back to empty bars. But ignoring food for an entire session will hurt.$()$(br2)Server owners can adjust rate and interval in the config.
